name: Vyapar Books PRO
releaseNotes: Payment In and Payment Out now use a dedicated entry mode with optional links to outstanding invoices and bills
Manual, oldest-first, and on-account allocation keep settlements separate from invoices and bills
Invoice and bill Pay & Save behavior is unchanged, with source vouchers reconciled safely on edits
GST-exclusive and GST-inclusive rates stay synchronized across screens, A4 bills, and thermal receipts
Legacy records, tax slabs, HSN summaries, and audit hashes remain intact
